outcome: SGA/LGA (Small for Gestational Age/Large for Gestational Age)
cohort: 89 hyperglycemic mothers were included in the study.
finding: The Nutrition and Behavior Modification Program (NBMP) significantly reduced blood glucose and BMI, lowered the risk of SGA/LGA and preterm/post-mature birth, and improved maternal exercise duration and emotional well-being in hyperglycemic mothers.
